title: Musk's Bad Week: Tesla Slumps, SpaceX Dips Before Starship
excerpt: Elon Musk faced a turbulent week as Tesla shares plunged almost 18% in the worst slump since 2022, while SpaceX experienced a valuation drop ahead of the crucial Starship test flight. This article analyzes the causes and implications of these setbacks for Musk's empire and the industries they lead.
description: Tesla shares drop 18% after earnings miss; SpaceX valuation dips before Starship test. A thorough analysis of the causes and implications for Musk's empire.
